dialogues.jp: 昼休み。俺は、屋上へと来ていた。
dialogues.en: "Do I have something on my face?"
dialogues.text: "Do I have something on my face?"

dialogues.jp: 彼女に呼ばれたのだ。
dialogues.en: "No, you don't. You wanted to talk to me?"
dialogues.text: "No, you don't. You wanted to talk to me?"

dialogues.jp: 重い扉を開く。一陣の風が吹き抜けた。
dialogues.en: I feel uncomfortable and quickly get to the point.
dialogues.text: I feel uncomfortable and quickly get to the point.

dialogues.jp:
屋上には、ひとりの女子学生が居るだけだった。
風になびく髪を押さえ、フェンスの外に身体を
向けている。
dialogues.en:
"Before we talk, can you please call me Misaki? And can I
call you Junichi as well?"
dialogues.text:
"Before we talk, can you please call me Misaki? And can I
call you Junichi as well?"

dialogues.jp: その背中に、｛デジャヴ／既視感｝を覚えた。
dialogues.en: "What? Yeah...... okay."
dialogues.text: "What? Yeah...... okay."

dialogues.jp:
それは、夜の桜並木。頼子さんとの、訓練の風
景……。
dialogues.en:
I glance at her and look down at the concrete around my
feet. The wind is strong and a bit cold.
dialogues.text:
I glance at her and look down at the concrete around my
feet. The wind is strong and a bit cold.

dialogues.jp:
あの緊張に縮こまっていた背中が、今のリラッ
クスした背中に、何となく重なる。
dialogues.en: I can hear the wind roaring hard.
dialogues.text: I can hear the wind roaring hard.

dialogues.jp:
扉の開閉音に気が付かなかったのか、彼女はフェ
ンスに向いたまま、じっと｛たたず／佇｝んでいる。
dialogues.en: I'm expecting her to say something so I just wait.
dialogues.text: I'm expecting her to say something so I just wait.

dialogues.jp: 何と言って呼びかけようか。
dialogues.en: But she doesn't talk. I wonder why, and look up at her.
dialogues.text: But she doesn't talk. I wonder why, and look up at her.

dialogues.jp:
迷った末に、結局｛・・・・・・・・・・・・・／名前の重なり合っている部分｝
を口にした。
「……鷺澤さん」
dialogues.en: "Wh-What's the matter?"
dialogues.text: "Wh-What's the matter?"

dialogues.jp:
間近にある鷺澤さんの顔に、まじまじと見入っ
てしまう。
dialogues.en:
I'm shocked to see her crying and I'm about to reach my
hands toward her.
dialogues.text:
I'm shocked to see her crying and I'm about to reach my
hands toward her.

dialogues.jp:
その顔は、確かに頼子さんと、とても良く似て
いた。
dialogues.en: But then I stop.
dialogues.text: But then I stop.

dialogues.jp: けれど、どことなく、何となく、違う。
dialogues.en:
This girl isn't Yoriko-san. I can't have intimate contact
with her.
dialogues.text:
This girl isn't Yoriko-san. I can't have intimate contact
with her.

dialogues.jp: 顔にかかる影の形。
dialogues.en: "......What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "......What's wrong?"

dialogues.jp: 笑顔の、唇の角度。
dialogues.en: I hold my hands behind my back and ask her again.
dialogues.text: I hold my hands behind my back and ask her again.

dialogues.jp: 瞳の、光を反射する具合。
dialogues.en: "......It's been about 205 hours......"
dialogues.text: "......It's been about 205 hours......"

dialogues.jp:
細かい部分では違っていて、けれど、全体とし
て見ると、頼子さんと見まがうほど似ている。
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「私の顔に、何か付いていますか？」
dialogues.en: "...since I said goodbye to you that night......"
dialogues.text: "...since I said goodbye to you that night......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「いや、別に。で、話って？」
dialogues.en: "I missed you...... I really missed you......"
dialogues.text: "I missed you...... I really missed you......"

dialogues.jp:
変に居心地が悪くて、つい、性急に話を進めて
しまう。
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san......?"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san......?"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「その前に、私のことは美咲と呼んでくれます
　か？」
dialogues.en:
My voice is hoarse and it leaks out from my throat. And my
hands want to reach out to her again.
dialogues.text:
My voice is hoarse and it leaks out from my throat. And my
hands want to reach out to her again.

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　あ、ああ……ま、いいけど」
dialogues.en: "......No, I am not Yoriko."
dialogues.text: "......No, I am not Yoriko."

dialogues.jp:
ちらりと顔を窺って、足下のコンクリートに目
をやる。風が強く、少し肌寒い。
dialogues.en:
She shakes her head. But this time I can't stop my hands. I
hold her shoulders.
dialogues.text:
She shakes her head. But this time I can't stop my hands. I
hold her shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
ごうごうと、風の｛うな／唸｝りが、遠く近くに聞こえて
くる。
dialogues.en: "What do you mean? Can you please explain what is going on?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean? Can you please explain what is going on?"

dialogues.jp:
彼女が何かを言うものと思って、俺はそのまま
耳を傾けていた。
dialogues.en: "It started with the power of the cherry tree."
dialogues.text: "It started with the power of the cherry tree."

dialogues.jp: が、無言のまま。不審に思い、顔を上げた。
dialogues.en: She wipes her tears and starts to talk.
dialogues.text: She wipes her tears and starts to talk.

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.en: "Or...... I should say it was already starting when..."
dialogues.text: "Or...... I should say it was already starting when..."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「ちょ、ちょっと？　どしたの？」
dialogues.en:
"...when I started to watch you from the window and fell in
love with you......"
dialogues.text:
"...when I started to watch you from the window and fell in
love with you......"

dialogues.jp:
泣き顔に驚き、身体に触れようとして思わず手
を差し出す。
dialogues.en: "Me......? You saw me and my sister walking to school?"
dialogues.text: "Me......? You saw me and my sister walking to school?"

dialogues.jp: それが、空中で止まった。

彼女は、頼子さんじゃない。あまり親しげには
出来ない。
dialogues.en:
She nods, and before she lifts her head she cocks her head
inquiringly.
dialogues.text:
She nods, and before she lifts her head she cocks her head
inquiringly.

dialogues.jp: 「……どうした？」
dialogues.en:
"How did you know that I was watching you when you were
walking to school?"
dialogues.text:
"How did you know that I was watching you when you were
walking to school?"

dialogues.jp: 手を背中で組み、再び｛たず／訊｝ねる。
dialogues.en: "......I just guessed."
dialogues.text: "......I just guessed."

dialogues.jp:
しゃがれた声が、のどから漏れる。また、手が、
彼女の身体を求めた。
dialogues.en:
I didn't tell her about my supernatural power of seeing
other people's dreams.
dialogues.text:
I didn't tell her about my supernatural power of seeing
other people's dreams.

dialogues.jp:
首を振る。けれど今度は、手が止まらなかった。
肩の辺りで、彼女を挟み込むようにする。
dialogues.en:
And I haven't had been in anyone's dream since the cherry
tree died.
dialogues.text:
And I haven't had been in anyone's dream since the cherry
tree died.

dialogues.jp: 「どういうことなんだ？　説明してくれ」
dialogues.en:
In addition to that, the power I used to have to create
sweets out of thin air is also gone.
dialogues.text:
In addition to that, the power I used to have to create
sweets out of thin air is also gone.

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「始まりは、桜の持つ力でした」
dialogues.en:
"I told you before that the cherry tree on this island had
the power to make people's wishes come true, didn't I?"
dialogues.text:
"I told you before that the cherry tree on this island had
the power to make people's wishes come true, didn't I?"

dialogues.jp: 涙をぎゅっと拭い、彼女はそう切り出した。
dialogues.en: "......Yoriko-san did."
dialogues.text: "......Yoriko-san did."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「あるいは……その前から始まっていたと言え
　るかもしれません」
dialogues.en: "......That's right."
dialogues.text: "......That's right."

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷く。と、首を傾げた。
dialogues.en: She smiles slightly.
dialogues.text: She smiles slightly.

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「通学の途中と、良く分かりましたね？」
dialogues.en:
"Junichi-kun, you told me it was just a rumor...... but it
was true."
dialogues.text:
"Junichi-kun, you told me it was just a rumor...... but it
was true."

dialogues.jp:
夢見る能力については、ややこしいだけなので、
伏せることにした。
dialogues.en: "I bet it was."
dialogues.text: "I bet it was."

dialogues.jp:
それに、桜が枯れて以来、一度も他人の夢を覗
き見ていない。
dialogues.en:
I shrug. I guess the power I used to have was also given by
the cherry tree.
dialogues.text:
I shrug. I guess the power I used to have was also given by
the cherry tree.

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「島の、とある桜が、人の願いを叶える力があ
　るという事は、前に言いましたね？」
dialogues.en: "And I had one wish. And it was......"
dialogues.text: "And I had one wish. And it was......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「……頼子さんが」
dialogues.en:
"...to fall in love with you and have you falling in love
with me."
dialogues.text:
"...to fall in love with you and have you falling in love
with me."

dialogues.jp: 彼女はそこで、軽く微笑んだ。

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉さんはあの時、噂だって言いましたけれ
　ど……ほんとに、本当のことなんです」
dialogues.en: "But my wish didn't come true after all."
dialogues.text: "But my wish didn't come true after all."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「だろうな」
dialogues.en: "Because my wish was...... not 'sincere'."
dialogues.text: "Because my wish was...... not 'sincere'."

dialogues.jp: 俺は軽く肩をすくめてみせる。
dialogues.en: "......What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "......What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「そして、私には一つの願いがあったんです。
　それが──」
dialogues.en: "I was...... afraid to go outside."
dialogues.text: "I was...... afraid to go outside."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「あなたと、結ばれること」

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.en: "My father was a very strict man."
dialogues.text: "My father was a very strict man."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「けれど、結局それは、叶えられませんでした」
dialogues.en: "I say he was...... but he's still alive."
dialogues.text: "I say he was...... but he's still alive."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「何故なら、私の願いは……｛・・・・・／真摯なもの｝ではな
　かったから」
dialogues.en: She smiles slightly when she says it.
dialogues.text: She smiles slightly when she says it.

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「願っているフリをして、その実、願ってなど
　いなかったんです」
dialogues.en: "And he told me one day."
dialogues.text: "And he told me one day."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「……それは、どういう意味？」
dialogues.en:
"He told me that I should stay in the house because I could
get a bad influence from my friends."
dialogues.text:
"He told me that I should stay in the house because I could
get a bad influence from my friends."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「私は……外に出るのが、怖かったんです」
dialogues.en:
"I was sad and mad but I listened to him. I couldn't disobey
my father."
dialogues.text:
"I was sad and mad but I listened to him. I couldn't disobey
my father."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.en: "And I started to stay in my room every day......"
dialogues.text: "And I started to stay in my room every day......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「私の父は、厳格な人でした」
dialogues.en:
"And it became natural to have someone with me whenever I go
somewhere......"
dialogues.text:
"And it became natural to have someone with me whenever I go
somewhere......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「でした……と言っても、まだまだ元気なもの
　ですけれど」
dialogues.en: "And I started to be afraid to go outside alone."
dialogues.text: "And I started to be afraid to go outside alone."

dialogues.jp: 口調に、ほんの少しだけ笑みをにじませる。

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「そんな父に、ある日言われたのです」
dialogues.en:
"How can a girl fall in love with a boy when she can't even
go outside by herself?"
dialogues.text:
"How can a girl fall in love with a boy when she can't even
go outside by herself?"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「友達から悪い影響を受ける恐れがあるから、
　外出は控えろ、と」
dialogues.en: She glances at me. Her eyes are full of tears.
dialogues.text: She glances at me. Her eyes are full of tears.

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「悲しかったし、悔しかったけれど、私は従い
　ました。父には逆らえませんでしたから」
dialogues.en:
"As long as I was afraid, I couldn't fall in love with
anyone, let alone meet anyone......"
dialogues.text:
"As long as I was afraid, I couldn't fall in love with
anyone, let alone meet anyone......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「そうやって、毎日の時間を、部屋で過ごすよ
　うになるうちに……」
dialogues.en: "That's why my wish was not sincere."
dialogues.text: "That's why my wish was not sincere."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「どこに出るにも、家の人間がついてくるのが、
　当然のようになってしまううちに……」
dialogues.en: "But...... Yoriko-san came to me......"
dialogues.text: "But...... Yoriko-san came to me......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「いつしか私は、外に恐怖を覚えるようになっ
　たんです」
dialogues.en: "There was one who always listened to my futile wish."
dialogues.text: "There was one who always listened to my futile wish."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.en: "It's my cat, Yoriko. I always talk to her."
dialogues.text: "It's my cat, Yoriko. I always talk to her."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「外にさえ出られない者が……どうして、恋な
　んて出来るでしょう？」

ちらりとこちらに目を向ける。瞳が、涙でにじ
んでいた。
dialogues.en: 'Please beckon his heart to me'
dialogues.text: 'Please beckon his heart to me'

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「その恐怖を抱いている限り、誰かを好きにな
　るどころか、接点さえ持てない……」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko is my best friend. So......"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko is my best friend. So......"

dialogues.jp:
お願い……あの人の気持ちを……私の方へ招い
て。
dialogues.en: "So your cat had a sincere wish for you."
dialogues.text: "So your cat had a sincere wish for you."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「頼子は私の一番の友達なんです。だから……」
dialogues.en: "That's right."
dialogues.text: "That's right."

dialogues.jp:
彼女は記憶を眺めるような遠い目をして、先を
続けた。
dialogues.en:
She looks away like she's recalling her memories, and then
she continues talking again.
dialogues.text:
She looks away like she's recalling her memories, and then
she continues talking again.

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「あの日……窓から頼子が飛び出していってし
　まったんです」
dialogues.en: "That day...... Yoriko ran away through a window."
dialogues.text: "That day...... Yoriko ran away through a window."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことは初めてで、私は気が気じゃあり
　ませんでした」
dialogues.en:
"She never did something like that before, so I was very
worried."
dialogues.text:
"She never did something like that before, so I was very
worried."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「家の者やバイトの方を雇って、探しに出ても
　らいましたが、まるで見つかりません」
dialogues.en:
"My family and part-timers I hired looked for her, but they
couldn't find her at all."
dialogues.text:
"My family and part-timers I hired looked for her, but they
couldn't find her at all."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「やがて、日が暮れて夜になり、まんじりとも
　しないまま、夜中になってしまいました」
dialogues.en: "It started to get dark without a trace of her."
dialogues.text: "It started to get dark without a trace of her."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「……やがて真っ暗な部屋の窓を、小石がこつ
　こつノックしました」
dialogues.en:
"......And around midnight that night, someone threw pebbles
at my window."
dialogues.text:
"......And around midnight that night, someone threw pebbles
at my window."

dialogues.jp: その時の光景を思い浮かべる。
dialogues.en: I try to picture the scene of that night.
dialogues.text: I try to picture the scene of that night.

dialogues.jp:
思い詰めたような表情。部屋の隅かベッドの上
で膝でも抱えていたかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
She was probably sitting hugging her knees at the corner of
her room or on her bed, with an anguished look on her face.
dialogues.text:
She was probably sitting hugging her knees at the corner of
her room or on her bed, with an anguished look on her face.

dialogues.jp: 窓の鳴る音。ふっと顔を上げ、耳をそばだてる。
dialogues.en:
The sound of a pebble hitting the window. She quickly looked
up and listened.
dialogues.text:
The sound of a pebble hitting the window. She quickly looked
up and listened.

dialogues.jp: また、ノック。訝しく思いながら、窓際へ。
dialogues.en:
There was another knock on the window. She walked to the
window with suspicion.
dialogues.text:
There was another knock on the window. She walked to the
window with suspicion.

dialogues.jp: 訪問者とは、一糸まとわぬ姿の、頼子だった。
dialogues.en: The visitor was Yoriko, who was completely naked.
dialogues.text: The visitor was Yoriko, who was completely naked.

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「直感でしょうか。一目見た途端、その女性が
　頼子であると分かりました」
dialogues.en:
"I guess it was my intuition. When I saw her, I knew she was
Yoriko."
dialogues.text:
"I guess it was my intuition. When I saw her, I knew she was
Yoriko."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「私は、頼子を部屋に招じ入れました。そして、
　次に気づいた瞬間には……」
dialogues.en: "I let her into my room, and the next moment......"
dialogues.text: "I let her into my room, and the next moment......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「私は、横たわる自分の身体を見下ろしていた
　んです。不思議と驚きはありませんでした」
dialogues.en:
"I was looking down at myself lying on the floor. Strangely
I was not surprised at all."
dialogues.text:
"I was looking down at myself lying on the floor. Strangely
I was not surprised at all."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「…………。なるほどな。話が見えてきた。こ
　ういうことじゃないかな」
dialogues.en: "............I see. I see it now. So this is what happened."
dialogues.text: "............I see. I see it now. So this is what happened."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「厳密に言って、頼子は招き猫ではなかった」
dialogues.en: "To be specific, Yoriko wasn't a beckoning cat."
dialogues.text: "To be specific, Yoriko wasn't a beckoning cat."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "No."
dialogues.text: "No."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「猫の頼子が何を考えたのか、正確には分から
　ない。ともかく、頼子の願いはこうだった」
dialogues.en:
"We don't know what exactly Yoriko had on her mind, but her
wish was..."
dialogues.text:
"We don't know what exactly Yoriko had on her mind, but her
wish was..."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「｛・・・・・・・・・・／自分の身体を貸すから｝、あなたの恋を成就し
　てください」
dialogues.en:
"...to make your wish to fall in love with me come true by
using her own body."
dialogues.text:
"...to make your wish to fall in love with me come true by
using her own body."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「けれど、私は、そこでも臆病者だったんです」
dialogues.en: "But I was still scared..."
dialogues.text: "But I was still scared..."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「頼子の行為に勇気づけられて、外には出る決
　心がつきました。けれど……」
dialogues.en:
"Yoriko's action helped me to make up my mind to go outside,
but......"
dialogues.text:
"Yoriko's action helped me to make up my mind to go outside,
but......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「どうやってあなたと接点を持てばいいのか、
　それが分からなかったんです……」
dialogues.en: "I didn't know what to do to meet you......"
dialogues.text: "I didn't know what to do to meet you......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「私は、私として……鷺澤美咲として、あなた
　にぶつかるのが……怖かった」
dialogues.en: "I was scared...... to meet you as Misaki Sagisawa......"
dialogues.text: "I was scared...... to meet you as Misaki Sagisawa......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「しばらく考えて、私は、家にあったメイドの
　服を借りることにしました」
dialogues.en:
"So I thought about it for a while and decided to borrow the
uniform of a maid who lived in my house."
dialogues.text:
"So I thought about it for a while and decided to borrow the
uniform of a maid who lived in my house."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「それを身にまとうと、期待した以上に、気分
　がフッと軽くなったんです」
dialogues.en:
"When I put it on, I felt better and my heart was lighter
than I expected."
dialogues.text:
"When I put it on, I felt better and my heart was lighter
than I expected."

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、｛・・・・・・・・・・・・・／これで私は鷺澤美咲ではない｝」
dialogues.en: "I felt like I was not Misaki Sagisawa anymore......"
dialogues.text: "I felt like I was not Misaki Sagisawa anymore......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「……そうだったのか……」

ご主人様とメイド。それは、あらかじめ与えら
れた関係だった。
dialogues.en:
A master and a maid. It was a situation that was already set
up.
dialogues.text:
A master and a maid. It was a situation that was already set
up.

dialogues.jp:
見知らぬ他人。あるいは、同級生。それらより
はたぶん、ずっと強い結びつきの。
dialogues.en:
It was a situation with a stronger connection than just
being total strangers or being classmates.
dialogues.text:
It was a situation with a stronger connection than just
being total strangers or being classmates.

dialogues.jp:
テーブルに用意された料理を、ただ食べるみた
いなものだ。
dialogues.en: It was like eating food that was prepared on the table.
dialogues.text: It was like eating food that was prepared on the table.

dialogues.jp: 用意された関係に、彼女は逃げ込んだのだ。
dialogues.en: She escaped to a situation that was already prepared.
dialogues.text: She escaped to a situation that was already prepared.

dialogues.jp: 自分で作ることはせずに。
dialogues.en: She didn't try to make it on her own.
dialogues.text: She didn't try to make it on her own.

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「その後は、朝倉さんも知っての通りです……」
dialogues.en: "After that, you know what happened......"
dialogues.text: "After that, you know what happened......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「俺は頼子さんが好きになって、頼子さんも俺
　を好きだと言ってくれた……」
dialogues.en:
"I came to love Yoriko-san, and she told me she loved me
too......"
dialogues.text:
"I came to love Yoriko-san, and she told me she loved me
too......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「そして、俺は鷺澤美咲なんて名前、ほとんど
　聞いたこともなくて……」
dialogues.en: "And she never talked of the name Misaki Sagisawa......"
dialogues.text: "And she never talked of the name Misaki Sagisawa......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「それが、私の後悔でした」
dialogues.en: "That's my regret."
dialogues.text: "That's my regret."

dialogues.jp:
後悔でしたと言い切る彼女は、不思議なくらい、
晴れ晴れとした表情だった。
dialogues.en:
When she says that it's her regret, her expression is
strangely bright.
dialogues.text:
When she says that it's her regret, her expression is
strangely bright.

dialogues.jp: まるで、春の、この空のように。
dialogues.en: Just like the sky in spring.
dialogues.text: Just like the sky in spring.

dialogues.jp: ──キ〜ンコンカ〜ンコン……。
dialogues.en: Ding, dong, dang, dong......
dialogues.text: Ding, dong, dang, dong......

dialogues.jp:
チャイムの音。その拍子に、二人を包み込んで
いた停滞した空気が、解けたように思った。
dialogues.en:
When I hear the sound of the school bell, I feel the
stagnant air that was surrounding us suddenly start to flow.
dialogues.text:
When I hear the sound of the school bell, I feel the
stagnant air that was surrounding us suddenly start to flow.

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "I am sorry."
dialogues.text: "I am sorry."

dialogues.jp: 深々と頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: She bows her head really low.
dialogues.text: She bows her head really low.

dialogues.jp: 「何が？」
dialogues.en: "Why?"
dialogues.text: "Why?"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp:
「鷺澤頼子という人間は、もう居ません。それ
　を、残念に思ってくれているかもしれません
　けれど……」
dialogues.en:
"Yoriko Sagisawa doesn't exist anymore. You may be kind
enough to feel sad about it, but......"
dialogues.text:
"Yoriko Sagisawa doesn't exist anymore. You may be kind
enough to feel sad about it, but......"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、いや、まあ、いいんだ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's okay... I'm fine..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's okay... I'm fine..."

dialogues.jp: 何となく笑みを浮かべ、ゆっくりと首を振る。
dialogues.en: I slightly smile and shake my head.
dialogues.text: I slightly smile and shake my head.

dialogues.jp: 確かに、一つの物語は終わりを告げた。
dialogues.en: Actually one story did end.
dialogues.text: Actually one story did end.

dialogues.jp:
二人の人間を縦糸と横糸とした布は、もうこれ
以上、編まれる事はない。
dialogues.en: The story of those two people will never continue on.
dialogues.text: The story of those two people will never continue on.

dialogues.jp: けれど、糸そのものが尽きた訳じゃない。
dialogues.en:
But it doesn't mean that there won't be another story that
will begin.
dialogues.text:
But it doesn't mean that there won't be another story that
will begin.

dialogues.jp: 新しい物語が、再び幕を開ける。
dialogues.en: There will be a new story.
dialogues.text: There will be a new story.

dialogues.jp: 一つの物語は終わり、新しい物語が。
dialogues.en: One story ends, and a new story begins.
dialogues.text: One story ends, and a new story begins.

dialogues.jp:
「え〜と、何て言ったかな。いつだったか覚え
　たんだよ。音楽用語で何て言ったかな、ええ
　と…。あ、そうだっ」
dialogues.en:
"Umm, what was it...? I learned the word before. It's a
musical term...... Oh, yeah!"
dialogues.text:
"Umm, what was it...? I learned the word before. It's a
musical term...... Oh, yeah!"

dialogues.jp: 「ダ・カーポだ！」
dialogues.en: "Da Capo!"
dialogues.text: "Da Capo!"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「ダ・カーポ？」
dialogues.en: "Da Capo?"
dialogues.text: "Da Capo?"

dialogues.speaker: Sagisawa
dialogues.jp: 「始まりに戻る、だよ」
dialogues.en: "It means it ends at a beginning."
dialogues.text: "It means it ends at a beginning."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、慣れないウインクを送った。
dialogues.en: I winked at her.
dialogues.text: I winked at her.

dialogues.jp: 彼女──｛・・／美咲｝は、｛そうこう／相好｝を崩した。
dialogues.en: The girl --Misaki-- smiles broadly.
dialogues.text: The girl --Misaki-- smiles broadly.

dialogues.speaker: Misaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうだ、あの時の指輪まだ持っていますか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you still have the ring?"
dialogues.text: "Do you still have the ring?"

dialogues.speaker: Misaki
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、そりゃもちろん、机の奥にちゃんとし
　まってある」
dialogues.en:
"What? Oh, of course I do. I've been keeping it inside the
very back of my desk."
dialogues.text:
"What? Oh, of course I do. I've been keeping it inside the
very back of my desk."

dialogues.speaker: Misaki
dialogues.jp: 「それ、捨てずに取っておいて下さいね」
dialogues.en: "Please don't throw it away."
dialogues.text: "Please don't throw it away."

dialogues.speaker: Misaki
dialogues.jp: 「いつか、必要になるかもしれませんから」
dialogues.en: "You may need it some day."
dialogues.text: "You may need it some day."

dialogues.jp: そして、さっきの俺のようにウインクした。
dialogues.en: And she winks at me just like I did to her earlier.
dialogues.text: And she winks at me just like I did to her earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Misaki
dialogues.jp:
「あっ、そういえば、チャイムが鳴っているん
　でした。早く、戻らないとっ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, the school bell rang. We have to hurry and go."
dialogues.text: "Oh, the school bell rang. We have to hurry and go."

dialogues.jp: ててて、と出入り口へ向かう。
dialogues.en: She runs to the door.
dialogues.text: She runs to the door.

dialogues.jp:
と、ドアの手前でくるっと振り返り、こちらに
戻ってきた。
dialogues.en: But she turns around near the door and comes back to me.
dialogues.text: But she turns around near the door and comes back to me.

dialogues.speaker: Misaki
dialogues.jp: 「一番肝心な事を言うのを、忘れていました」
dialogues.en: "I forgot to tell you the most important thing."
dialogues.text: "I forgot to tell you the most important thing."

dialogues.jp:
胸に手を当て、息を整え、両手をぎゅっと握り
しめる。
dialogues.en:
She puts her hands to her chest, takes a deep breath, and
clasps her hands tighter.
dialogues.text:
She puts her hands to her chest, takes a deep breath, and
clasps her hands tighter.

dialogues.jp: 知らず、俺も背筋を伸ばした。
dialogues.en: I automatically straighten up my back.
dialogues.text: I automatically straighten up my back.

dialogues.jp: それは、新しい物語の予感──。
dialogues.en: I have a hunch that a new story is about to begin ----
dialogues.text: I have a hunch that a new story is about to begin ----

dialogues.speaker: Misaki
dialogues.jp:
「２０５時間も待ったから、今ここで、告白し
　ちゃいます」
dialogues.en:
"Since I've been waiting for 205 hours, I'm going to just
tell you here."
dialogues.text:
"Since I've been waiting for 205 hours, I'm going to just
tell you here."

dialogues.speaker: Misaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくしこと、鷺澤美咲は──」
dialogues.en: "I, Misaki Sagisawa......"
dialogues.text: "I, Misaki Sagisawa......"

dialogues.jp: ◆ＥＤ・２０５時間後の告白◆
dialogues.en: ◆It's lunch break now. I came up on the roof.◆
dialogues.text: ◆It's lunch break now. I came up on the roof.◆

dialogues.jp:
俺は、転校生、鷺澤美咲に屋上に呼ばれた。似
ていても、彼女は頼子さんでは無い。だから俺
は、無意識に親しげにならないように接した。
dialogues.en: It's because she called me here.
dialogues.text: It's because she called me here.

dialogues.jp:
だけど彼女は、「２０５時間ぶりですね」と言っ
た。あの夜別れてからだという。
dialogues.en: I open the heavy door. A blast of wind blows through.
dialogues.text: I open the heavy door. A blast of wind blows through.

dialogues.jp:
では、彼女は頼子さんなのか……。だが、頼子
では無い、自分は美咲なのだ、と言う。俺が説
明を求めると彼女は語り始めた。
dialogues.en:
There's only one girl here. And she's holding her hair
waving in the wind and facing toward the fences.
dialogues.text:
There's only one girl here. And she's holding her hair
waving in the wind and facing toward the fences.

dialogues.jp:
全ての始まりが桜だったこと。島の人々の、真
摯で切実な願いを叶える、あの魔法の木が発端
だったということを。
dialogues.en: It's like I just had deja vu.
dialogues.text: It's like I just had deja vu.

dialogues.jp:
美咲の願いは、毎朝窓から見ていた俺と、結ば
れことだったと言う。だが、それは真摯な願い
では無かった。
dialogues.en:
A picture of the training day on the cherry blossom road at
night with Yoriko-san.
dialogues.text:
A picture of the training day on the cherry blossom road at
night with Yoriko-san.

dialogues.jp:
彼女の父は厳格で、上流階級たる家の娘が｛みだ／妄｝り
に外出などしてはならんと教えていたという。
dialogues.en:
I mentally overlap the hunched and tense back of Yoriko-san
with the relaxed back of this girl.
dialogues.text:
I mentally overlap the hunched and tense back of Yoriko-san
with the relaxed back of this girl.

dialogues.jp:
彼女の願いは、言うなれば外に出たいというこ
との裏返し、代償的な願いだったのだ、と。
dialogues.en:
It seems like she didn't notice the sound of the door being
opened and closed, and she's still facing toward the fences.
dialogues.text:
It seems like she didn't notice the sound of the door being
opened and closed, and she's still facing toward the fences.

dialogues.jp:
だが、真実｛しんし／真摯｝な願いを持つものが、彼女の傍
にいたのだ。それは猫の頼子だった。毎日少女
の呟きを聞いていた頼子。
dialogues.en:
I don't know what to call her. But in the end I call her by
'the same' 'last name'.
dialogues.text:
I don't know what to call her. But in the end I call her by
'the same' 'last name'.

dialogues.jp:
ある日、頼子が家を後にし、入れ替わるように
して女性が現れたという。それが頼子に違いな
いと少女は思った。
dialogues.en: "......Sagisawa-san."
dialogues.text: "......Sagisawa-san."

dialogues.jp:
そして、次の瞬間、自分の意識はその女性の体
の中にあったという。
dialogues.en: "Hello."
dialogues.text: "Hello."

dialogues.jp:
つまり、猫の頼子は「私の体を使ってあなたの
願いを成就してください」と言っていたのだと
少女は思ったという。
dialogues.en: "Hi, hello."
dialogues.text: "Hi, hello."

dialogues.jp: 恐らくそれは、そういうことなのだろう……。
dialogues.en: I can't stop staring at her face.
dialogues.text: I can't stop staring at her face.

dialogues.jp:
後押しされるようにして、外に出る決心のつい
た少女だったが、それでも面と向かって俺の前
に現れる勇気が無かったという。
dialogues.en: Her face looks just like Yoriko-san's.
dialogues.text: Her face looks just like Yoriko-san's.

dialogues.jp:
それで、登場するのがメイド服だ。メイドと主
人という、予め設定された、強い絆の関係に彼
女は逃げ込んだのだ。
dialogues.en: But somehow there are differences.
dialogues.text: But somehow there are differences.

dialogues.jp:
そして、彼女は俺の前に現れた……というわけ
である。
dialogues.en: The shadows on her face.
dialogues.text: The shadows on her face.

dialogues.jp:
俺はダ・カーポという言葉を思い出しながら、
彼女の告白を聞いた。
dialogues.en: The angle of her lips when she smiles.
dialogues.text: The angle of her lips when she smiles.

dialogues.jp:
あの日のおもちゃのリングを、必要な日まで大
切にとっておかなきゃな。
dialogues.en: The way her eyes reflect lights.
dialogues.text: The way her eyes reflect lights.

dialogues.jp: 新しい春、新しい始まり、それは新しい物語――
dialogues.en:
Those small parts are different... but as a whole face she
looks just like Yoriko-san.
dialogues.text:
Those small parts are different... but as a whole face she
looks just like Yoriko-san.
